title: Daily News Quiz · 2026-09-16
headline: A drug designed by artificial intelligence reverses biological age in a clinical study

questions.prompt: Who announced the new clinical study results on biological aging?
questions.hintKo: The company behind the study is Insilico Medicine.

questions.prompt: What did the six protein-based aging clocks show in treated patients?
choices: Exactly the same age as before
questions.hintKo: Every clock pointed toward a younger predicted biological age.

questions.prompt: When were the study results published and announced?
questions.hintKo: The study was published and announced in early September, twenty twenty-six.

questions.prompt: Where were the results presented on the eighth of September?
choices: At a shopping centre in Manila
At a conference at Sorbonne University in Paris
questions.hintKo: The presentation took place in Paris at Sorbonne University.

questions.prompt: Why do experts say the results must be treated with caution?
choices: The study was small and cannot yet separate slower aging from a treated lung
questions.hintKo: The caution comes from the small size of the study and the treated lung, not from missing data.

questions.prompt: How long did the company say it took to move from choosing a target to naming a candidate drug?
questions.hintKo: The timeline quoted by the company is about eighteen months.
